Summary: Windows MAX_PATH FileNotFoundError on fuzzed long filenames
Vulnerability / Defect Description: Fuzz testing with 300+ character filenames triggered Windows WinError 3 path limit.
Resolution / Fix Applied: Truncate stored filenames to <= 100 characters in local_client.py while preserving safe extension.

Summary: Rapid login fuzzing triggered sliding rate limiter 429
Vulnerability / Defect Description: Fuzz suite failed on 429 status code because test assumed only 400/422 responses.
Resolution / Fix Applied: Updated test assertion in test_auth_fuzz.py to validate 429 as expected defensive behavior.

Summary: Audit log blockchain verification alias discrepancy
Vulnerability / Defect Description: test_audit_logging imported verify_hash_chain while verifier defined verify_audit_log_integrity.
Resolution / Fix Applied: Added export alias verify_hash_chain = verify_audit_log_integrity in verifier.py.

Summary: Public share password verification case sensitivity
Vulnerability / Defect Description: Argon2id password verification was failing on whitespace padded input from modal.
Resolution / Fix Applied: Added strip() sanitization before passing candidate password to verify_password().
